source_text: Iudas offert se pro Beniamin. Ioseph: ego sum frater vester. Fletus et oscula — reconciliatio Christi cum fratribus.
pass_a_gloss: Judah offers himself for Benjamin. Joseph: I am brother your. Weeping and kisses — reconciliation of-Christ with brothers.
pass_b_english: [[Judah offers himself for Benjamin >> Bible:Genesis 44:18-34]]. [[Joseph: I am your brother >> Bible:Genesis 45:3-4]]. Weeping and kisses — Christ’s reconciliation with the brothers.
